title: dev.qory.session.started
description: A session joined the run: its runtime is about to start. One per join that starts, after the gateway's join answer and before the session's process starts, and before any dev.qory.run.log, dev.qory.run.resized or runtime event of the session, whose events follow it up to its dev.qory.session.exited. A refused join, one the gateway answered with a 403 or that failed the session's checks, has no dev.qory.session.started, only its dev.qory.session.exited. Each of runtime, image, image_name and container_runtime that contains qak_, qrk_ or qecr_ in any case is `(a name that contains an access key secret)` in its place, `(a name that contains a run key)` when it contains qrk_ and no qak_, or `(a name that contains a run code)` when it contains qecr_ and neither of the others. Each of dir, command, an argument, runtime_version, a name of setup_commands and a harness entry's source that contains one is `(a value that contains an access key secret)`, `(a value that contains a run key)` or `(a value that contains a run code)` in the same way.

session.description: The session's number in the run, from 1: the session of the gateway's join answer. The gateway numbers the run's joins in the order their requests arrive.

runtime_version.description: The runtime version Forager's adapter for it, such as a descriptor, was written against; Forager never checks the installed version. Absent for a bare runtime, whose records the session does not parse, and when the runtime's adapter reports no version.

command.description: The program started, as the runtime prepared it. In a run with a run key, each occurrence of the run directory, the harness home and the inputs directory in it is written as in args.

args.description: Its arguments, as the runtime prepared them. Environment is never reported. In a run with a run key, each occurrence in an argument, at any place in it, such as inside a prompt, of the run directory is <run>, of the harness home <home>, and of the inputs directory <inputs>, each at its path on the machine and at its path inside the enclosure, wherever it is not part of a longer name: where it starts the argument, follows file://, or follows a character other than / or one of a name (a letter, a digit, ., _, ~ or -), and where it ends the argument or is followed by / or a character other than one of a name. One or more of ., ? and ! after it count as such a character unless a character of a name comes next, so /srv/in. and /srv/in... match /srv/in, and /srv/in.bak and /srv/in?x=1 do not. The argument is replaced in one pass: at each place, of two of them where one contains the other, the longer is replaced, and the text written in its place is not replaced again. Any other path is as the runtime prepared it. The session's line session <n> starts on this machine, which the session reports on stderr by default, contains the command and the arguments as the session starts them.

dir.description: The working directory the runtime starts in, as the enclosure sees it: under a wall at the same path as on the machine, and /workspace, or a directory under it, when the policy names the image by its reference pinned by digest. Without a wall command and dir are the machine's; with one they are the enclosure's. In a run with a run key, dir is /workspace in every case, and the session's line session <n> starts on this machine contains the working directory on the machine.

setup_commands.description: The names of the session's setup commands, in the order they run: the commands the session runs inside the wall before the runtime, one after another, each a step of kind setup with its name, in dir, with the runtime's environment and through the run's proxy. The runtime starts once every one exits 0; a command that exits otherwise ends the session with its exit status, and neither a later command nor the runtime starts. command and args are then the script the session starts the runtime through, which runs the setup commands first. Absent when the session has none.

interactive.description: True when the session runs on a pseudo-terminal, false on pipes.

terminal.description: The size of the pseudo-terminal the runtime starts on: Forager's terminal's when it has one, 80 by 24 otherwise. Present when interactive is true, absent on pipes. Every change after that is one dev.qory.run.resized.

image.description: The image the enclosure runs, the reference. Present when the run has a wall.

image_name.description: The machine's name for the image, when the image is one the machine defines: the one the policy selected, or the machine's default by name. Absent for an image the policy names by its reference. A name that contains qak_, qrk_ or qecr_ in any case is one of three phrases in its place: the access key secret's when it contains qak_, else the run key's when it contains qrk_, else the run code's.

enum: (a name that contains an access key secret)
(a name that contains a run key)
(a name that contains a run code)

container_runtime.description: The container runtime the wall started the image under, as the machine's definition sets it: sysbox-runc. Absent means the engine's default.

docker.description: True when the enclosure has nested Docker, a Docker daemon inside the wall, separate from the machine's, started by the wall before the runtime. Absent otherwise.

harness.description: The harness sources the session's compose used, one entry per source, when the caller passes them: each source as it is configured, with the phrase in place of a source that contains qak_, qrk_ or qecr_ in any case, and the full commit id compose used. Forager changes nothing else in them. Absent when the caller passes none, and in a run with a run key, whose line session <n> starts on this machine contains each source and commit; never empty.

source.description: The source as it is configured, such as https://git.example/example-org/harness#main.

commit.description: The full commit id compose used, 40 or 64 hexadecimal characters, in lower case.
